title: Independent click throttling across consumers
turns: Give each returned click handler its own timing state; unrelated handlers must not suppress one another.
Preserve suppression inside the wait window, allow the exact boundary, and keep independent handlers after the change.

acceptance: Disappear/reappear does not show a stale indicator.
Small/large delay and cancellation checks pass.
title: Loading lifecycle across breakpoints
turns: Make repeated loading appearances start a fresh delayed indicator and cancel old timers.
Allow breakpoint changes while loading without stale indicator callbacks.

acceptance: Rejected submission preserves state; retry succeeds.
Repeated click creates one submission; success clears state.
title: Feedback submission and reset
turns: Make feedback submission preserve selections until success and show a retryable failure.
Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve the previous success/reset behavior.

acceptance: Both consumers agree on URL cases.
Local/malformed inputs and previous remote cases are covered.
title: Consistent remote image classification
turns: Define and apply consistent HTTP/HTTPS image URL handling across component and preview.
Add malformed/relative/local URL behavior while preserving remote preview.

acceptance: Push/replace/pop postconditions checked with a stack oracle.
Failure reaches caller; previous success checks remain passing.
title: Navigation replacement and error outcome
turns: Expose a usable navigation operation outcome while preserving stack and animation behavior.
Propagate failure outcomes to one actual caller without losing successful navigation behavior.
